title: Battery Recycled-Content Audit
description: EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542 · Art. 8 · Annex XIII §3 — per-substance third-party verification of recycled content claims. The producer's recycled-content percentage on the battery passport (e.g. 'cobalt 12 %') is only credible if backed by a third-party audit.

substance.description: Which substance does this audit cover. Only these five substances have mandatory recycled-content targets under Art. 8.

scope.description: Audit scope — which segment of the supply chain the verifier covered.

verifier_name.description: Legal name of the third-party verifier. Required.

notified_body_id.description: Optional FK to a notified-body record if the verifier is an EU notified body.

recycled_pct.description: Recycled-content percentage declared in this audit (% by weight, w/w).

issued_date.description: Date the audit was issued (YYYY-MM-DD). Required.

expires_date.description: Optional expiry date of the audit.

report_url.description: Public URL of the audit report PDF.

report_hash.description: Optional SHA-256 hash of the audit PDF for tamper-evidence (64 hex chars).

notes.description: Free-text notes about the audit, exceptions or limitations.
